title: Where the Ice Lets Go
description: Cracked pale shelves are both slippery and fragile; exposed stone is the place to prepare.

signs.text: Cracked ice gives way · prepare on the stone
The thaw has broken the old continuous ice road
Leave the cracked spans before they fall
Keep jumps small beneath the culvert roof
The rock holds while the ice below breaks
One final chain of fragile frozen shelves
